misprints.note: The print clearly shows iota with an acute accent. ζωρίς is not attested.

uncertain.note: At this resolution I could not tell whether the accent on ὄν/ὤν is acute or grave (the OCR read τὸ ὂν). I wrote acute.
The middle ending looks like εῖα (circumflex, no breathing), not εἴα. I wrote εῖα.
The OCR had ἀθλος. The scan shows ἄδηλος, but the breathing and accent are small. The comma after 2 is as printed.
